say:1:1230418001:1.text: He passed away during a voyage.
say:1:1230418001:1.source_cn: 出海就再也没回来，死了。
say:1:1230418001:1.male: He passed away during a voyage.
say:1:1230418001:1.female: He passed away during a voyage.

say:2:1230418002:1.text: This is very common in our village. Many have lost their husbands to the sea.
say:2:1230418002:1.source_cn: 这太常见了，我们村子不少人的男人都是出海的时候没能回来。
say:2:1230418002:1.male: This is very common in our village. Many have lost their husbands to the sea.
say:2:1230418002:1.female: This is very common in our village. Many have lost their husbands to the sea.

say:3:1230418003:1.text: This happens to almost everyone here. The older women in the village often advise me to move on.
say:3:1230418003:1.source_cn: 这很常见。村里年纪大一些也总劝我。
say:3:1230418003:1.male: This happens to almost everyone here. The older women in the village often advise me to move on.
say:3:1230418003:1.female: This happens to almost everyone here. The older women in the village often advise me to move on.

say:4:1230418004:1.text: But there's a constant heavy weight on my chest that gives me the urge to scream.
say:4:1230418004:1.source_cn: 可是我的心里像是有什么压着，总想喊一喊。
say:4:1230418004:1.male: But there's a constant heavy weight on my chest that gives me the urge to scream.
say:4:1230418004:1.female: But there's a constant heavy weight on my chest that gives me the urge to scream.
